en.quote: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation. I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
en.riddle: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation. I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
en.speaker: Job

he.quote: קֹדֵר הִלַּכְתִּי בְּלֹא חַמָּה קַמְתִּי בַקָּהָל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ אָח הָיִיתִי לְתַנִּים וְרֵעַ לִבְנוֹת יַעֲנָֽה
